fixed_normal.rule: test split, normal rows sorted by image_id ascending, first 6

fixed_anomaly.rule: test split, anomaly rows sorted by image_id ascending, first 6

worst_iou.rule: anomaly rows sorted by iou ascending (null treated as -1), ties by image_id

worst_recall.rule: anomaly rows sorted by recall ascending (null treated as -1), ties by image_id

most_normal_fp.rule: normal rows sorted by false-positive pixels descending, ties by image_id

rules.notes: selection lists may overlap; every row keeps its own reason. Rules were written before the first test image was decoded and are hashed into evaluation_meta.json.
